positive: Worst reported hold deficit is about 90 ps and mean negative slack is about 12.08 ps, a scale normally addressable by local delay/buffer insertion.
The DDC is linked to both slow/max and fast/min standard-cell and macro views, contains nine resolved immutable macros, and has no timing loop or design-rule violation.
No RTL change, clock-period change, path exception, or macro replacement is required in principle.
risks: There are 9992 violating paths, so fanout sharing and area cost cannot be inferred from aggregate QoR alone.
Setup margin is only 1.795 ps; even a hold-targeted mapping may perturb a max path and must be rejected if setup becomes negative.
The -0.09 ns and -120.72 ns values are rounded QoR diagnostics; exact pre-fix min-path evidence must be captured inside the future run before optimization.
Ideal clock and ZeroWireload make this pre-layout closure only, not post-CTS or post-route signoff.

dc_ddc_incremental_only_hold.reason: DC owns the frozen DDC mapping, can use the exact min libraries and set_fix_hold, can perform one hold-only incremental mapping, and can emit a self-contained mapped Verilog/SDC/DDC/SVF identity for Formality and independent PT.
forbidden_adjacent_passes: compile_ultra -incremental before or after the hold-only pass
generic compile -incremental_mapping after the hold-only pass
a second hold-only pass under the same identity

primetime_hold_eco.reason: PrimeTime is the stronger independent analyzer, but this workspace has no sealed PT-ECO implementation flow, DEF/SPEF or physical insertion context. A fix_eco_timing change list would require a second implementation boundary before a new netlist exists and would add license, application and Formality ambiguity without improving the ideal-clock/ZeroWireload model.
primetime_hold_eco.permitted_role: independent slow/max and fast/min validation after the DC-generated netlist exists

unique_recommended_future_flow.output_identity: a fresh additive one-shot result directory and attempt marker derived from M993; never overwrite or mutate M993/M1006
ordered_steps: Verify the complete M993 and M1006 seals plus every pinned DDC/SDC/netlist/library/tool identity before consuming a fresh attempt.

In DC, read_ddc, link, bind the same slow target and fast min standard-cell/macro libraries, read the exact mapped SDC, preserve 3.000 ns, setup uncertainty 0.200 ns, hold uncertainty 0.050 ns, ideal clock and ZeroWireload, and recheck exactly nine dont-touch macros.
Before optimization, capture exact min top paths, all negative min paths, WNS/TNS/count, setup, design-rule, unconstrained and loop diagnostics.
Apply set_fix_hold only to core_clk and execute exactly one compile -incremental_mapping -only_hold_time. Do not run compile_ultra -incremental or any generic mapping pass before or after it.

Capture post-fix max/min top paths and all violators, QoR, area, references, macro binding, clocks, constraints and check_design/check_timing; write new mapped Verilog, mapped SDC, DDC and SVF without changing the input artifacts.

Run a separately authorized Formality gate-to-gate proof from exact M993 mapped Verilog to the new mapped Verilog; for complete C1 admission also close direct frozen M935 RTL plus macro-wrapper to the new mapped identity.
Run separately authorized inert PrimeTime slow/max plus fast/min validation on the new netlist. PT reports timing only; it does not perform ECO in this flow.

success_gate.dc_setup: WNS >= 0, TNS = 0, violating paths = 0 at 3.000 ns and 0.200 ns setup uncertainty
success_gate.dc_hold: WNS >= 0, TNS = 0, violating paths = 0 at unchanged 0.050 ns hold uncertainty
success_gate.prime_time: independent slow/max setup and fast/min hold both MET with zero unconstrained diagnostics; no ECO commands
success_gate.constraints: zero false paths, multicycle paths, min/max-delay exceptions, disabled arcs and case analysis; clock and I/O constraints unchanged
success_gate.macros: exactly nine TS1N28HPCPHVTB128X128M4S instances before and after; no behavioral macro substitution

area.rule: Always report absolute area and overhead. Above 5 percent may be sealed as a hold-closed engineering result but is not admitted as preserved C1 PPA.

success_gate.formality: verify return PASS; zero failing, unmatched, unverified and aborted points. Gate-to-gate is mandatory for this ECO; direct RTL-to-new-netlist proof is required before complete C1 paper admission.
success_gate.claim_boundary: pre-layout macro-aware component hold closure only; no power, energy, routed timing, cycle speedup, system speedup or paper-PPA claim

stop_conditions: Any input, seal, tool, library, clock, SDC or macro identity drift.
Any unresolved reference, timing loop, unconstrained diagnostic, design-rule failure or macro count other than nine.
Any post-fix setup or hold violation in DC or independent PT.
Area greater than 154608.7116945 um2 for positive C1 PPA admission.
Any false/multicycle/min/max-delay exception, disabled timing arc, case analysis, clock-period relaxation or uncertainty relaxation.
Any Formality failing, unmatched, unverified or aborted point.
Any tool crash, OOM or incomplete artifact set: seal as failed and do not retry the same identity.
Failure of the single hold-only pass: do not append compile_ultra, a generic mapping pass, a second hold-only pass or manual path surgery. Stop and require a separately reviewed new experiment.
